messages.subject: Meeting Thursday 10-noon
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

This Thursday (1/9) will be the first D-RUG for the Winter Quarter (details below). This week during D-RUG we will have office hours and discuss plans for the quarter to come. Datalab will also be open for Tea Time and Co-working on Thursday afternoon.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Conference Room, Library 362

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
